issue.title: test_new_process_loads_remembered_admin_center_section fails under full parallel runs and passes in isolation
issue.description: The Config Center process-resume persistence test has failed in three full parallel runs on unrelated trees since 2026-09-06, including a clean current-master verification, but passes on an immediate serial rerun. The test creates two AcePage processes and expects the second to observe a tab-history write from the first; investigate synchronization, state isolation, and background-save completion under xdist load rather than widening waits blindly.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed in full-run records 20260906T205004Z-a45669b26fd3, 20260907T135748Z-e2ce985dd5b0, and clean 20260907T184446Z-a9f95ca5e645. The current clean run had 39,277 passes and only this node plus the already-tracked Models runner-limit flake; immediate unchanged-tree serial rerun passed in 3.19s. Observed fail/pass so far from retained records: at least 3 full-parallel failures and 1 direct serial pass. Current pager and source-syntax commits do not touch Config Center persistence.
